notes.subject: ol man i ranawe bilong en
notes.rationale: בריחה lexicon i tok 'bolt' (pen bilong dua), tasol ol transleita ol i ridim olsem 'ol man i ranawe' (bilong ברח); tupela ridin i stap.

notes.subject: pikinini bulmakau bilong tripela yia
notes.rationale: עגלת שלשיה: sampla i lukim olsem nem bilong ples (Eglat-Shelishiya), sampla olsem 'pikinini bulmakau bilong tripela yia' — singaut bilong bulmakau i save kamap olsem krai long gaden.

notes.subject: זעק / זעקת / יעערו
notes.rationale: Rot bilong singaut i kamap gen na gen long vers — יזעק, זעקת, יעערו — wanpela nois i go long heed, Tok Pisin i holim wantaim 'singaut'.

translation: Bel bilong mi i singaut long Moab; ol man i ranawe bilong en i go inap long Soar, olsem pikinini bulmakau bilong tripela yia; long wanem, long ples bilong go antap Luhit ol i go antap wantaim krai; long wanem, long rot bilong Horonaim ol i kirapim singaut bilong bagarapim olgeta.
